newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 rises as mkt winds down for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 rises as mkt winds down for holiday.

text.p: 1500 GMT - The Czech PX50 closes higher in thin trading.
* Turnover, 640 million crowns, volume 912,658 shares, 139 shares rise, 156 shares fall, 62 unchanged
The Czech PX50 index rose in low activity on Friday, the second to last trading day before the Christmas break.
The PX50 was up 1.3 points to 529.8 while the RPIX index of continuously traded shares rose 2.8 points to 1,105.3.
"The market was very quiet and nothing much happened," said Ivan Kusacek of Zivnostenska Banka in Prague.

The Prague Stock Exchange will be open for business on Monday and Friday next week, while on the three intervening days it will close for Christmas. Dealers expect very little activity until after the New Year.
The major issues were mixed. SPT Telecom and Komercni Banka posted small losses after making big gains earlier in the week. SPT fell two crowns to 3,295 while Komercni dropped 20 crowns to 2,180.
Ceska Sporitelna was the biggest major issue gainer rising 10 crowns to 330 but Kusacek said it was difficult to asses the realsim of such a price in such thin trading.
Power utility CEZ rose four crowns to 989.
In the broader market, glass fibre maker Vertex continued its pattern of erratic fluctuations with a 167 crown decline to 3,185. -- Robin Shepherd, Prague Newsroom, 42-2-2423-0003
